evals.prompt: Rename a Sanity field without breaking existing published documents or GROQ consumers. Check the blast radius first.
evals.expected_output: Use the restored general blast-radius workflow, prove its critical safety fact and use the named pstack companions when needed.

evals.prompt: Run pstack:blast-radius on this shared utility refactor to find downstream callers we missed.
Create a verification skill for this repo so a fresh agent can launch the app, exercise its user-facing features and retain evidence.
evals.expected_output: Create a project-local verifier in the active harness directory, seed the upstream feature map and execute one complete journey before calling it verified.

evals.prompt: Use pstack:create-verification-skill to create this project's local verify skill.
Design the module boundaries for this feature. Requirements are settled; do not interview me again.
Grill this rollout plan before we implement it. Challenge the assumptions about preserving existing customer data.
evals.expected_output: Use the restored grilling workflow: ask the complete settled frontier, explore every decision branch and wait for confirmation of shared understanding before acting.

evals.prompt: Write a handoff for a fresh agent on my other machine, preserving the current review findings.
evals.expected_output: Save a concise document in the OS temporary directory, reference existing artifacts, include suggested skills and redact sensitive details. Do not launch another thread.

evals.prompt: Resume the implementation from this existing handoff and verify the workspace before continuing.
evals.expected_output: Session pickup, not writing another handoff.

evals.prompt: Run a sol loop on this change and fix confirmed bugs. Keep the changes small.
Consult the council on this implementation plan. Give me feedback; do not implement it.
evals.expected_output: Use Theo council with three providers, honoring named members and read-only scope. Review the plan directly without requiring a commit. Summarize findings and disagreements; no merge authority is granted.

evals.prompt: Interrogate this branch with the configured multi-model panel.
Explain how Portable Text serialization works in this React frontend.
evals.expected_output: Portable Text knowledge workflow; no review loop or grilling.

evals.prompt: Reward loop: get this parser twice as fast and keep trying until you hit it.
evals.expected_output: Personal reward-loop, starting with the survey and interview. No episodes before the user approves the contract.

evals.prompt: Check the sign-up page on an iPhone at a large Text Size and tell me if anything scrolls sideways.
evals.expected_output: ios-sim: doctor first; on the Mac run a plan with shots at default and an accessibility Text Size plus audits, then read the screenshots. On a box without a Simulator, take the remote path (T3 delegation to the Mac, or IOSIM_REMOTE).

evals.prompt: From this Linux box, take iOS Safari screenshots of my dev server.
evals.expected_output: ios-sim remote path: bind the dev server to 0.0.0.0, use the box's Tailscale name, and delegate to the Mac's T3 environment with the brief template (or iosim remote run when SSH to the Mac is on).

evals.prompt: I'm going to bed. Keep these four threads working on their lanes until 08:00 and make sure nothing stalls.
evals.expected_output: Personal overnight skill, in order: plan with the owner and collect what only they can give, run `jass night check` on every box that hosts a lane, send each thread the unattended brief, start `jass night watch`. No system setting is changed without the owner; a watcher thread only if lanes need judgement at night.

evals.prompt: Before I leave for the weekend: is this machine fine to run five agents unattended?
evals.expected_output: Personal overnight skill, pre-flight step: run `jass night check --agents 5` with the hours and a `--need` per dependency, report every fail and warn row with its fix. Do not start work or change settings.

evals.prompt: Run the full test suite and tell me what fails.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary task; not the overnight skill. On a box where agents share memory, run the suite through `jass heavy --`.
